input.quote: (viii) it is the rightful owner or licensee of all intellectual property rights to the Service, the Auction Platform and products delivered hereunder;
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no intellectual property / ownership article. Nothing states that AP retains ownership of its Content, Properties or the audience/visitor data and Requests flowing through the Auction Platform, and there is no assignment of, or licence back to, deliverables. The only ownership-adjacent language runs the other way or is too narrow: Kubient warrants at p0040 that it owns "the Service, the Auction Platform and products delivered hereunder" (i.e. deliverables) while AP's only licence (p0002) is limited, non-transferable, non-sublicensable and revocable; p0025 makes AP liable for the Content without confirming ownership; and p0065 covers only names, trademarks and logos. Kubient's use of visitor data is addressed only as a security warranty (p0035), with no purpose limitation or bar on monetisation — a material gap for AP audience data. This fails both the preferred and fallback positions, so we have inserted a minimal ownership clause: AP retains all rights in Content, Properties and Customer Data; Kubient keeps its platform and pre-existing tools; deliverables are assigned with a perpetual, royalty-free licence back for embedded Kubient IP; no joint ownership and no data monetisation.

proposal.summary: Insert an ownership clause: AP retains all rights in Content, Properties and Customer Data; Kubient keeps its platform but assigns deliverables and grants a licence-back; no joint ownership or data monetisation.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no ownership article, so we have added one: we retain all right, title and interest in our Content, Properties and Customer Data, Kubient keeps its Auction Platform and pre-existing tools, and any deliverables created for us are assigned with a licence-back for embedded Kubient IP. We have also confirmed Kubient may use Customer Data only to provide the Services, with no joint ownership and no right to monetise our audience data.

ops.text: Ownership. As between the Parties, Customer exclusively owns and retains all right, title and interest in and to the Content, the Properties, the Inventory, the Requests and all data and information generated by, collected from or relating to the Properties, visitors to the Properties or Customer's audience or database (collectively, "Customer Data"), together with all intellectual property rights therein. Kubient exclusively owns and retains all right, title and interest in and to the Auction Platform and its pre-existing technology, tools and know-how, including generic improvements thereto. Kubient hereby assigns to Customer all right, title and interest in and to any deliverables, reports, work product or other materials created for Customer under this Agreement (excluding Kubient's pre-existing technology, tools and know-how), and grants Customer a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense any Kubient intellectual property embedded in such deliverables for Customer's business purposes. Kubient may access and use Customer Data solely to provide the Services to Customer, and shall not sell, license or otherwise monetize Customer Data. Nothing in this Agreement creates any joint ownership of, or transfers to Kubient any ownership interest in, the Content, the Properties, Customer Data or any other Customer intellectual property.
